title: [DocDB] Large error messages in AsyncRpc::Failed causing OOM, when there are large number of failed requests that acquire a lot of locks.
body:
Jira Link: [DB-10293](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-10293)
### Description

**Please view JIRA description for more resources, slack thread and stress links.**

This pattern is consistently seen in multiple runs.

![Screenshot 2024-03-11 at 1 41 25 PM](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/assets/109518123/b58c9804-08a3-4f94-952b-20a22fe23e95)


During testing, it was observed that there was a significant increase in memory usage within a short period, leading to an out of memory crash. The following sequence of events was noted:

We are retrieving heap snapshot every 15 seconds in the test

_Test report:_ In JIRA (59012)

- Node n3 (IP: 172.151.28.190) went down ~12:51:17
- There was a 4 GB increase in memory usage within 15 seconds (from 12:51:00 to 12:51:15) (PFA)
- At 12:51:11, the first instance of memory hitting the limit appeared in WARN logs.
- We’ve captured a heap snapshot at 12:51:09.

these are the suspected stacktraces with significant memory usage (its 2.3 GB, some time before crash). Please note, its generated only in this snapshot and not present anywhere before (even ~20 seconds earlier):

```
1,175,740,416 (1.17 GB)

tcmalloc::tcmalloc_internal::SampleifyAllocation<>()
tcmalloc::tcmalloc_internal::(anonymous namespace)::do_malloc_pages<>()
slow_alloc<>()
TCMallocInternalNew
yb::(anonymous namespace)::DupMessage()
yb::StatusToPB()
yb::client::internal::AsyncRpc::Failed()
yb::client::internal::TabletInvoker::Done()
yb::client::internal::AsyncRpc::Finished()
std::__1::__function::__func<>::operator()()
yb::rpc::OutboundCall::InvokeCallbackSync()
yb::rpc::(anonymous namespace)::Worker::Execute()
yb::Thread::SuperviseThread()
start_thread
```

```
1,137,549,312 (1.13 GB)

tcmalloc::tcmalloc_internal::SampleifyAllocation<>()
tcmalloc::tcmalloc_internal::(anonymous namespace)::do_malloc_pages<>()
slow_alloc<>()
TCMallocInternalNew
google::protobuf::internal::ArenaStringPtr::CreateInstanceNoArena()
yb::client::internal::AsyncRpc::Failed()
yb::client::internal::TabletInvoker::Done()
yb::client::internal::AsyncRpc::Finished()
std::__1::__function::__func<>::operator()()
yb::rpc::OutboundCall::InvokeCallbackSync()
yb::rpc::(anonymous namespace)::Worker::Execute()
yb::Thread::SuperviseThread()
start_thread
```

Please refer 2 consecutive heap snapshots attached, for complete snapshot:
[12_50_49.pdf](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/14560658/12_50_49.pdf)
[12_51_09.pdf](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/files/14560661/12_51_09.pdf)

3 workloads were being run:

* SqlDataLoadWithDDL on non-colocated DB
* SqlDataLoadWithDDL on colocated DB
* BankTransfer on colocated DB
